title: TJX revenue exceeds estimates as company raises annual comparable-sales forecast, Reuters reports
summary: TJX reported third-quarter revenue above analysts’ estimates and raised its full-year comparable-sales forecast, according to Reuters. In its earnings release, TJX reported net sales of $15.952 billion and said CEO Ernie Herrman expected sales momentum to accelerate during the holiday season. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: TJX results and analyst estimates compiled by LSEG
Reports company results and analyst estimates from a Zacks Investment Research survey; the story was generated by Automated Insights using Zacks data.
Compares reported revenue with the Zacks Consensus Estimate.

responses.text: In TJX's earnings release, Herrman said sales, profitability and earnings exceeded company expectations and that he expected sales momentum to accelerate during the holiday season.

title: Witnesses tell Reuters Israeli tanks advanced beyond the Yellow Line in central Gaza
summary: Witnesses told Reuters that Israeli tanks advanced beyond the Yellow Line in central Gaza on Wednesday. The Israeli military said the operation targeted Hamas infrastructure, while Hamas called the raid and evacuation a ceasefire violation, Reuters reported. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Israeli civilian-military agency COGAT's statement and Palestinian media reports
Witnesses, Palestinian medics and an Israeli military spokesperson

responses.text: Said the operation targeted Hamas infrastructure west of the Yellow Line, according to Reuters.
Called the raid and evacuation a violation of the ceasefire, according to Reuters.

title: Forbes reports Xint found five NGINX flaws; NGINX announces security updates
summary: Forbes reported that Xint found five NGINX vulnerabilities, including one that could permit remote code execution without authentication, and that F5 confirmed the findings. The NGINX project announced versions 1.30.7 and 1.31.9 with vulnerability fixes in its [release notice](https://nginx.org/2026.html). The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Interview with Xint CEO Brian Pak and confirmation from NGINX maintainer F5.
Reports the disclosures by Xint and other research teams, including Wiz, and cites their published findings and vulnerability databases.

responses.text: Forbes reported that F5 confirmed the five flaws and said it was patching them.
Announced versions 1.30.7 and 1.31.9 with fixes for multiple vulnerabilities.

title: Broward declared a local emergency after flooding, Axios and WLRN report
summary: Axios and WLRN reported that Broward County declared a local state of emergency following heavy rain and flooding. County administrator Monica Cepero’s declaration cited flooding and forecasts of further dangerous conditions, while Hollywood officials said crews were responding with high-water vehicles and urged residents to avoid flooded roads. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Reports the county declaration and includes photographs by an Axios journalist of flooding in Hollywood.
Reports the county declaration and quotes a news release advising drivers to avoid flooded roads.
Reports the county and city declarations and cites National Weather Service rainfall estimates, a city advisory and a Florida Public Radio Emergency Network meteorologist.

responses.text: Declared a local state of emergency throughout Broward County, citing flooding and forecasts of further dangerous conditions.
Said emergency crews were responding with high-water vehicles and advised residents to avoid flooded roads.

title: Reuters and Axios report Trump and Putin are expected to meet in China
summary: Reuters and Axios reported, citing officials, that President Donald Trump and President Vladimir Putin are expected to meet in China on Thursday. Russian news agencies quoted Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov as saying the meeting would follow the APEC plenary session and include members of both delegations. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: U.S. and Russian officials
U.S. officials

responses.who: Yuri Ushakov, Kremlin foreign policy aide
responses.text: Russian news agencies quoted Ushakov as saying the meeting would follow the APEC plenary session and include members of both delegations.

title: Cornyn tells AP he will withhold support for Gaiser's nomination to a Texas federal judgeship
summary: Sen. John Cornyn told The Associated Press he would withhold his blue slip for Elliot Gaiser's nomination to a federal judgeship in Texas. Reuters separately reported that a Senate aide said Cornyn had withheld support for Gaiser to appear before the Senate Judiciary Committee. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Interview with Sen. John Cornyn
A Senate aide said Cornyn withheld support for Gaiser to appear before the Senate Judiciary Committee.

responses.text: Cornyn told AP that Gaiser was not from Texas, had not undergone the customary vetting process and that better-qualified candidates were available.

title: CBS News reports L3Harris took hours to locate outage behind nationwide ground stop
summary: CBS News reported, citing a person familiar with the investigation, that L3Harris took several hours to locate the outage's source, delaying the lifting of Friday's nationwide ground stop. AP reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the contractor did not identify and isolate the router issue quickly enough. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: A person familiar with the investigation and another source, as well as sources describing the contractor’s response.
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in a Wednesday interview that the contractor failed to identify and isolate the router issue quickly enough.

responses.text: L3Harris told CBS News its network operations center monitors latency and outages around the clock and referred the outlet to an earlier statement saying it supported the FAA investigation.

title: Bloomberg and Reuters report Anthropic IPO pricing of $83 a share
summary: Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, above its target range of $70 to $78, Bloomberg and Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter. Anthropic declined to comment to Reuters. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: People familiar with the matter.
One person familiar with the matter, who requested anonymity because the information was not public.

title: Thune says Republican votes for $350 billion defense package remain uncertain, CBS reports
summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune said it remained uncertain whether Republicans had enough votes to pass a $350 billion defense funding package through reconciliation, CBS News reported. Axios separately reported on the funding discussions, citing Thune's remarks and interviews with House Republicans. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Thune's remarks after Republican conference meetings and an interview with CBS News.
Thune's remarks to reporters and interviews with House Republicans, including Budget Committee Chair Jodey Arrington.

responses.text: CBS News reported that Thune said Republicans were exploring Democratic support for defense funding while retaining reconciliation as an option.

title: Reuters reports Anthropic IPO raised $81.31 billion
summary: Reuters reported, citing a person familiar with the matter, that Anthropic’s IPO raised $81.31 billion after the offering was expanded. AP reported that Anthropic announced an offering of 980 million shares, including approximately 956 million sold by the company and the remainder by selling stockholders. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: One person familiar with the matter.
Cites Anthropic's announcement of the offering and share allocation.

responses.text: According to AP, Anthropic said the offering included 980 million shares, with approximately 956 million sold by the company and the remainder by selling stockholders.
